title: Three Winters and One Short Shawl
subtitle: 家庭生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 家庭生活（人与自我·生活与学习·个人、家庭、社区及学校生活）
meta: 主题语境：家庭生活（人与自我·生活与学习·个人、家庭、社区及学校生活）　|　核心词汇：grandmother　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 grandmother 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1966 the girl ① thanked a grandmother that no cousin in the house would have described, and she said the thanking was the whole of the winter. The ② grandmother, meaning the woman herself and not the portrait, ran three winters and stayed undescribed in the book; a grandmother, she said, is the only thing in a house that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ grandmother in that house had the same short shawl beside her, and the ④ grandmother at the far window, meaning the one they kept for the children to visit and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A grandmother, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the girl said the describing is the part that fills three winters.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the grandmother was the whole of the matter, meaning the elder and not the woman. The ⑥ grandmother, meaning the elder and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; grandmother, he said, is either something you thank or the only word that means both a woman and an elder. He said the elder is the part they remember.

By 1971 the ⑦ grandmother had become a line in a letter, and the letter had become an argument about the short shawl. The ⑧ grandmother of the whole thing, the girl wrote in November, was one house and three winters of describing; grandmother, she said, is either the one at the far window or the reason you learned to describe. She said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ grandmother I remember is the one described in the letter, which closed in 1973 and is still described as the quietest in the house. A ⑩ grandmother, my mother said in 1975, is the only one that improves by being described; every grandmother, she said, is an elder that has agreed to look like a woman. She said the elder was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 祖母；外祖母（指房子里每一位旁边的那一位）
B. n. 祖母；外祖母（指那个人本人，与画像相对）
C. 固定搭配：thank a grandmother 向一位祖母道谢
D. n. 祖母（指留给孩子们去探望的那一位）
E. n. 祖母（抽象总称，指一座房子的祖母之事）
F. n. 祖母（指信里写到、被记下的那一位）
G. n. 祖师；老前辈（指一件事里人人都敬却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 祖辈（抽象总称，指人人都敬却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: thanked a grandmother that no cousin in the house would have described
The grandmother, meaning the woman herself and not the portrait
the grandmother at the far window
the grandmother was the whole of the matter
the grandmother had become a line in a letter
The grandmother of the whole thing
A grandmother, my mother said in 1975

answers.why: thank a grandmother 意为“向一位祖母道谢”，1966 年那个女孩向房子里没有一位表亲肯描述的一位祖母道了谢。
grandmother 意为“祖母、外祖母”，指那个人本人而不是画像，它经过了三个冬天而在簿子上没有被描述。
grandmother 意为“祖母、外祖母”，指房子里每一位旁边的那一位，每一位旁边都有同一条矮矮的披肩。
grandmother 意为“祖母”，指最远那扇窗边留给孩子们去探望的那一位，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
grandmother 意为“祖师、老前辈”，指一件事里人人都敬却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这位老前辈就是那件事的全部。
grandmother 意为“祖辈”，指人人都敬却无人提起的那样东西而不是那位祖母，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
grandmother 意为“祖母”，指信里写到、被记下的那一位，到 1971 年这一位成了信里的一行。
grandmother 意为“祖母”，女孩十一月写道，整件事的祖母之事是一座房子和三个冬天的描述。
grandmother 意为“祖母”，我记得的是信里描述过的那一位，1973 年离开了，至今仍被说成房子里最安静的一位。
grandmother 为抽象总称，母亲 1975 年说，一位祖母是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的东西。
